shortDescription: Manages configuration on Cisco FTD devices over REST API

options.name: data
options.description: Key-value pairs that should be sent as body parameters in a REST API call

options.name: filters
options.description: Key-value dict that represents equality filters. Every key is a property name and value is its desired value. If multiple filters are present, they are combined with logical operator AND.

options.name: operation
options.description: The name of the operation to execute. Commonly, the operation starts with 'add', 'edit', 'get', 'upsert' or 'delete' verbs, but can have an arbitrary name too.

options.name: path_params
options.description: Key-value pairs that should be sent as path parameters in a REST API call.

options.name: query_params
options.description: Key-value pairs that should be sent as query parameters in a REST API call.

options.name: register_as
options.description: Specifies Ansible fact name that is used to register received response from the FTD device.
